reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending and copyPreviousMonth, goes through isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories, and the sign rule is shared via toBudgetedAverage (also reused by setNMonthAvg); existing getCategoryAverage, getSheetValue, extractTagsFromText are reused.

duplication.why: The three copied category queries and average loops are collapsed into one selection function and setMonthAverage; the only overlap left is getBudgetData re-selecting the same has_template/cat_group/group_hidden columns that getMonthFillCategories selects.

placement.why: The selection rule, the #fixed group lookup and the new action live in budget/actions.ts beside the actions, with the handler registered in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, the new method, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: One documented predicate with an explicit 'copyable'/'visible' scope makes the preserved null-group inconsistency visible; small blemishes are toBudgetedAverage being reused for last-month net spending with an extra Math.max clamp, and two data paths (getBudgetData vs getMonthFillCategories) feeding the predicate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No month-wide action keeps its own hidden/income/template filtering; all call isMonthFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: Removed copies are genuinely replaced by shared functions; the remaining column list overlap between getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories is overt.

abstraction_drift.where: isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories take scope (step 0, preserved inconsistency) and includeHiddenCategories (step 4), with the scope==='visible' and !includeHiddenCategories branches; template and #fixed rules are folded in as base conditions; no call site bypasses it.
